age.description: Patient's age in years at discharge.

deprivation_decile.description: Area deprivation of the patient's home, 1 = most deprived, 10 = least.

long_term_conditions.description: Number of long-term conditions on the record.

emergency_admissions_prev_12m.description: Emergency admissions in the year before this one.

length_of_stay_days.description: Days in hospital for this admission.

number_of_medications.description: Medicines the patient is discharged on.

discharge_destination.description: Home, home with a care package, or care home.

discharge_specialty.description: The specialty the patient was discharged from.

discharge_day.description: Day of the week of discharge.

gp_contacts_since_discharge.description: GP contacts in the 30 days after discharge. Only known once those 30 days have passed.

outpatient_followup_attended.description: Whether an outpatient follow-up was attended. Only known afterwards.

community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.description: Community nursing visits in the 30 days after discharge. Only known afterwards.
